title: End User Profile And Preferences Self Service Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the end user profile and preferences self service capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: Self-service profile and notification preference lifecycle: read self, update self; dispatch honours enabled preferences.

stateModel.description: Tenant- and user-scoped profile (displayName, locale, timezone) and per-channel/category preference rows; RLS tenant isolation.

permissions.description: profile.read_self and profile.update_self bound to the authenticated session subject; never a caller-supplied userId.

contracts.description: Self profile read/update and notification-preference read/update operations behind ports/adapters.

validation.description: Rejects empty displayName and invalid payloads; secret-bearing fields are not notifiable.

errorModel.description: Validation and no-tenant errors; deterministic outcomes, fail-closed on missing tenant context.

auditModel.description: Profile and preference changes are audited before the mutation is applied.

readinessModel.description: Always-on once persistence is migrated; readiness proofs skip honestly when the substrate is unavailable.

proof.description: Unit and runtime proof of self-service behaviour. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: No verified UI source path in the manifest yet; author the UI semantic model or import the UI source row before generation.
